bull.t: Surf On Demand Growth And Margin Expansion
bull.b: Rapid growth in Surf On Demand revenue, departures, and revenue per departure indicates strengthening customer adoption and better utilization of the platform. Gross-margin expansion and access to preferred aircraft partners could support a more durable contribution from this segment as scale increases.

Positive airline adjusted EBITDA and lower operating costs show that the core service can improve its economics even before the technology initiatives mature. Continued gains in fuel efficiency, labor productivity, and reserve utilization may strengthen margins and reduce dependence on expansion-driven growth.

bull.t: SurfOS Commercial Traction And Platform Expansion
bull.b: Commercial deployment with multiple operators gives SurfOS an emerging software platform position alongside the airline business. Revenue-share economics, additional AI-enabled modules, and an identified enterprise pipeline could create a higher-margin growth engine once implementations convert into recurring activity.

bear.b: The company remains far from sustainable profitability despite revenue growth and reduced losses from 2023. Near-breakeven gross profit and substantial operating expenses leave limited financial resilience, making successful execution of margin improvements essential to support the business over coming quarters.

bear.t: Heavy Cash Burn And Funding Dependence
bear.b: Continued negative operating and free cash flow means the business is consuming substantial capital to fund operations and investment. Persistent burn reduces flexibility to absorb setbacks or accelerate growth internally, while management expects cash-flow breakeven only after adjusted EBITDA breakeven.

bear.t: Negative Equity And A Thin Capital Buffer
bear.b: Negative equity leaves the company with little balance-sheet cushion against operating setbacks and makes leverage measures less informative. Although debt declined from prior periods, the capital structure remains dependent on external funding and successful execution to rebuild financial stability.
